query: Do federal judges appointed by different Presidents (Trump vs. other Republican vs. Democratic) differ in their voting tendencies on immigration injunction cases? Do Trump-appointed judges tend to be more supportive of Trump administration immigration policies compared to judges appointed by other Republican or Democratic presidents?

schema.name: judge_name
schema.definition: The full name of the federal judge presiding over the case or authoring the opinion.
schema.rationale: Necessary to identify the specific judge whose voting tendencies and appointment background are being analyzed.

schema.name: appointing_president
schema.definition: The U.S. President who appointed the judge to the federal bench.
schema.rationale: Directly addresses the core query comparing Trump-appointed judges with those appointed by other Republican or Democratic presidents.

schema.name: appointing_president_party
schema.definition: The political party of the President who appointed the judge.
schema.rationale: Allows grouping of judges by appointing party (Republican vs. Democratic) to analyze broader voting tendencies.

schema.name: ruling_on_injunction
schema.definition: The court's decision regarding the requested preliminary injunction or temporary restraining order.
schema.rationale: Captures the judge's vote/ruling on the immigration injunction, which is the dependent variable of the research question.
allowed_values: granted in part and denied in part

schema.name: challenged_immigration_policy_administration
schema.definition: The presidential administration that promulgated the challenged immigration policy or rule.
schema.rationale: Allows researchers to determine if Trump-appointed judges are more supportive of Trump administration policies specifically, compared to other administrations' policies.

schema.name: challenged_policy_description
schema.definition: A brief description of the specific immigration policy, rule, or program being challenged in the case.
schema.rationale: Provides essential context on the type of immigration issue (e.g., unaccompanied minors, legal representation, funding) being decided.
allowed_values: Unaccompanied Children Program sponsor documentation and income requirements
Termination of Legal Orientation Programs (LOP, ICH, FGLOP, CCI)
Rescission of National Qualified Representative Program (NQRP)
